This method is designed to be rendered directly from the compressed domain using GPU fragment shaders, avoiding full decompression.
*   **Time Complexity**: Encoding is $O(N)$ where $N$ is the number of voxels, due to block-wise processing.

*   **Memory Complexity**: The compressed size is $3 \times (N_x/4)(N_y/4)(N_z/4)$ bytes for the index texture, plus $256 \times 64 \times \text{sizeof(float)}$ for $C_1$ and $256 \times 8 \times \text{sizeof(float)}$ for $C_2$.
